backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor that manages study sessions, Pomodoro timers, and user goals with functions to record sessions, track distractions, and query session data stored in maps and lists.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four features to revert Version 6 changes: removing FocusGuard logo from Header, reverting Dashboard styling, and restoring Version 5 light/dark mode theming.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components, pages, and hooks describing UI redesigns with minimal aesthetics, camera monitoring, distraction detection, and timer functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining color schemes for light and dark modes using oklch color space with grayscale and accent colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the FocusGuard React application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, timer, and dashboard pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider and QueryClientProvider with Header/Footer layout.
frontend/src/components/CameraMonitor.ts: Floating camera monitor card component displaying video feed and status badges for face presence, phone detection, and seated status with minimize/maximize functionality.
frontend/src/components/CyclePrompt.tsx: Dialog component prompting users to start the next Pomodoro cycle or end the session after completing a break.
frontend/src/components/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard component displaying study metrics in cards including total study time, focused time, focus score, streak, with tabs for weekly/daily stats and insights using charts and progress indicators.
frontend/src/components/DistractionWarni: Displays an alert dialog with warning messages for different distraction types (phone, sleeping, face-not-detected, not-seated) with corresponding titles and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/FeatureCard.tsx: Renders a card component with an icon (image or ReactNode), title, and description, featuring hover animations and staggered fade-in effects.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Displays a footer with copyright information and a link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking parameters based on the current hostname.
frontend/src/components/GoalSetting.tsx: Provides a card interface for setting and editing daily study goals in hours and minutes, using the useStudyGoals hook for persistence.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Renders a sticky navigation header with buttons for Home, Timer, and Dashboard pages, plus a theme toggle component.
frontend/src/components/MotivationalQuot: Displays a random motivational quote from a predefined list, rotating every 5 minutes using an interval.
frontend/src/components/MusicControlButt: A button component that toggles music playback, showing different styles and animations when music is playing.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: A dialog-based music player with controls for play/pause, volume, category selection, loop mode, and custom playlist management including file import and track removal. (Content truncated)
frontend/src/components/SiteBlockWarning: Displays an alert dialog warning users that a site is blocked during their study session, showing the remaining time and a dismiss button.
frontend/src/components/StudyGraph.tsx: Renders a bar chart using Recharts to visualize daily study hours with custom styling for dark/light themes.
frontend/src/components/StudyTimer.tsx: Main timer component supporting Pomodoro and custom modes with auto-pause on distractions (phone, head down, face lost, not seated), cycle management, and integration with session callbacks. (Content truncated)
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: A button that toggles between light and dark themes using next-themes, displaying sun/moon icons with smooth transitions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages ICP backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, using React Query to cache actors and invalidate dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAudioPlayer.ts: Provides audio player functionality with multiple music categories, custom playlists stored in IndexedDB, volume control, loop mode, and track management for focus music playback.
frontend/src/hooks/useDistractionDetecti: Detects user distraction by monitoring page visibility and window focus events, tracking when the user switches away from the app and recording distraction start times.
frontend/src/hooks/useFaceDetection.ts: Implements face detection using webcam video analysis with skin tone detection, tracks face presence, head position, and eye state with smoothing algorithms to reduce false positives.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient configuration with delegation handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useObjectDetection.ts: Detects rectangular objects (potential phones) in webcam video using edge detection algorithms with optimized sampling and confidence scoring to identify distracting devices.
frontend/src/hooks/usePoseDetection.ts: Analyzes user posture from webcam video by measuring vertical brightness distribution to detect seated vs. standing positions, using adaptive baseline calibration for different study postures.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching all study sessions and recording new sessions via the backend actor, with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSiteBlocker.ts: Simulates detection of blocked social media sites during active study sessions, randomly triggering warnings with remaining time (note: actual blocking requires browser extension).
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyGoals.ts: Manages daily study goal (in minutes) with localStorage persistence and calculates progress toward goal achievement.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyStats.ts: Calculates comprehensive study statistics including daily/weekly hours, focus scores, streaks, distraction metrics, and performance insights from session data.
frontend/src/hooks/useTimer.ts: Manages study timer state for Pomodoro or custom sessions, tracking focused/paused/distraction time, handling auto-pause on distraction detection, and recording sessions to backend.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, color schemes, and animation utilities for fade-in, slide-up, and scale-in effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Simple page component that renders the Dashboard component within a container with padding.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section promoting FocusGuard, call-to-action buttons for starting sessions or viewing dashboard, and feature cards highlighting camera monitoring, music, blocking, and analytics.
frontend/src/pages/TimerPage.tsx: Main timer page that orchestrates study sessions with camera monitoring, face/object/pose detection, distraction warnings, site blocking alerts, and music player integration.
frontend/src/utils/audioStorage.ts: Provides IndexedDB utilities for storing, retrieving, and managing audio files locally with metadata (filename, format, playlist, timestamp). Includes functions to initialize the database, save/get/delete audio files, and list files by playlist.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including HSL-based color variables, custom spacing/font sizes, container settings, and animation keyframes for accordion components. Includes typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata for FocusGuard study productivity app defining architecture (React/Next.js, TensorFlow.js/MediaPipe for face detection, local camera processing), existing features (smart timer, camera monitoring, phone/distraction detection), and known browser/API limitations.
